title: My Kite Flies High | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes, Fun Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
A cheerful kite-flying song where a playful crow joins the fun and learns that sharing makes friends.
Kids learn about kindness, sharing, and having fun outdoors with family.
Sing along with the kite, the crow, and the big blue sky!

[Intro]
(la la la, la la la) x2

Up goes the kite, red and yellow
climbing, climbing, climbing high
up, up, up, up
see it fly, fly, fly!

Fly my kite, so high, so high
dancing in the big blue sky
wee, wee, wee, wee
kite, kite, you can fly!

Whoosh, a crow comes swooping by
grabs the tail with its beak
spin, spin, spin, spin
oh no! oh no!

Fly my kite, so high, so high
dancing in the big blue sky
wee, wee, wee, wee
kite, kite, you can fly!

The crow is only playing, see
little sister shares her crumbs
caw, caw, caw, caw
thank you, thank you!

Fly my kite, so high, so high
dancing in the big blue sky
wee, wee, wee, wee
kite, kite, you can fly!

Amma waves, "Come in, come in!"
kite and crow fly side by side
wave, wave, wave, wave
bye bye sky, bye bye!
